wire.name: settings
wire.sqlText:
with old as (select quota from byos_connections where id=$1 and "ownerId"=$2)
      update byos_connections set quota=$3 where id=$1 and "ownerId"=$2 and epoch=$4 and state='connected' returning (select quota from old) as previous

wire.name: allowance
wire.sqlText: update byos_connections set quota=$3||jsonb_build_object('plan',quota->'plan') where id=$1 and "ownerId"=$2 and epoch=$4 and state='connected' returning(select quota from byos_connections where id=$1 and "ownerId"=$2)as previous

reasoning.why: The former quota plan is a JSON string or null. Replacing any JSON string with null adds at most two bytes (the empty string boundary). Four unchanged parameter frames plus the two-byte smaller SQL therefore do not increase this PostgreSQL request for any candidate count N. With the same initial row, RETURNING previous and its wire result are unchanged.
limits: This is a per-saveQuota SQL/parameter/result proof against the same authorized row and quota fields, not a measurement of production traffic or task latency.
No saving is claimed from CTE execution; EXPLAIN has the same InitPlan read and target scan.

The private TS-to-Go method string length is separate from PostgreSQL traffic.
